ranked.headline: Single-cell data now localize genetic and disease effects to specific cell types
ranked.summary: Single-cell eQTL atlases, risk transfer, and perturbation screens now attribute regulatory and phenotypic effects to specific cell states.

ranked.headline: Computational models couple spatial statistics with histology and transcriptomic inference
ranked.summary: Histology features and foundation models are now coupled to spatial transcriptomic inference for regulatory, pathway, and tissue-scale questions.

ranked.headline: Simulated ground truth defines accuracy limits and tuning optima for sequencing tools
ranked.summary: Simulated and benchmarked ground truth is now used to locate where added coverage and parameter tuning stop yielding gains in sequencing analysis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and uncertainty estimates increasingly test molecular drug-response models
ranked.summary: Predictive molecular models are being judged on calibrated uncertainty and rigorous cross-dataset benchmarks, not headline accuracy alone.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings encode cell-gene and pathway structure for single-cell inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply contrastive, graph, prototype and autoencoder representations to scRNA-seq, spatial and multi-omic data.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models and multi-omics ML link microbial metabolites to host gene evidence
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous microbial, metabolic and multi-omics data are being recast as gene-level and association-level evidence for downstream interpretation.

ranked.headline: De novo, uncertainty-aware inference of chromosome organisation from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell data now support de novo inference of chromosome structure and identity, extended to evolutionary and single-genome questions.

ranked.headline: Data-efficient strategies for peptide and protein sequence classification
ranked.summary: Limited labeled data in peptide and protein sequence tasks is driving generative augmentation and training-free embedding approaches evaluated on benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models expose lineage-specific and promiscuous bacterial metabolism
ranked.summary: Genome-scale metabolic models and phylogenetic profiling now connect bacterial metabolic capacity to lineage history and gene co-evolution at scale.

ranked.headline: Pretrained representations adapt to pathology and CT tasks under limited supervision
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend pretrained vision and multimodal encoders to pathology, CT, and spatial proteomics tasks.

ranked.headline: Scoring transcriptomic, regulatory, and spatial features across tissues and disease
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add explicit quantitative scoring to single-cell, isoform, chromatin, and spatial analyses of gene-level and regulatory features.

ranked.headline: Threshold-based genomic identifiers are reshaping bacterial taxonomy and strain…
ranked.summary: Recent work formalizes bacterial taxonomy with cgMLST-based LIN codes and whole-genome k-mer sketching for hierarchical strain clustering.

ranked.headline: Reducing annotation dependence in cell imaging via synthetic data and foundation models
ranked.summary: Hand-annotated ground truth remains a bottleneck for quantitative cell imaging, driving synthetic, unsupervised, and foundation-model approaches.

ranked.headline: Open-source software standardises omics annotation, benchmarking and visualisation
ranked.summary: Recurring omics operations are being packaged into open-source tools with defined data structures and accessible interfaces.

ranked.headline: Post-calling variant refinement draws on population, phenotype, and read-level evidence
ranked.summary: Post-calling tools now combine population frequency, ACMG-style criteria, and read-level allelic patterns to inform individual variant decisions.

ranked.headline: Pretrained genomic language models transferred to narrow RNA and DNA prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent papers test whether pretrained DNA and RNA language models generalize across species, datasets, and RNA prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Energy models and folding pathways probe protein conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple learned energy models, coarse-grained potentials, and non-equilibrium free-energy methods to protein conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Learned scoring and flexible docking improve structure-based binding prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs geometric deep learning scoring and side-chain-flexible docking with large-scale target profiling and ADMET models.

ranked.headline: Controlled benchmarks test whether pretrained biomolecular encoders beat simple baselines
ranked.summary: Recent controlled studies report that simpler masking or encoding choices can match or exceed pretrained embeddings in molecular and single-cell settings.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence learning models predict drug, miRNA and disease associations
Computational models link RNA-binding proteins to splicing, translation and mRNA decay
ranked.summary: Sequence-based and omics-driven models now infer RBP regulation of splicing, translation and NMD from large RNA-seq and genomic resources.

ranked.headline: Compact indexes and alignment methods for pangenome, k-mer and ancient DNA data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications target pangenome path alignment, k-mer set storage, sketch density, and ancient DNA indexing in sequence workflows.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models predict residue identity, energetics, and substitutions
ranked.summary: Structure inputs now condition protein design, mutation energetics, substitution modeling, and RNA and MHC-peptide prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines prioritize neoantigens and off-target epitopes for immunotherapy
ranked.summary: Neoantigen-based immunotherapy trials and checkpoint response studies now demand scalable, multi-omics prioritization of tumor-specific targets.

ranked.headline: Graph and structure-based tools mine conserved interface and glycan 3D features
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published package extend graph-based and 3D structural mining of protein interfaces, glycans, and phage lysins.

ranked.headline: Structure-constrained models of neural responses and decoding across scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study constrain neural response models with connectivity, topology, or explicit design rather than phenomenological fitting.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage-aware profilers address false positives in metagenomics
ranked.summary: Recent releases package curated fungal, viral, and vaginal microbiome references and a cross-domain profiler as reusable resources for metagenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Neural surrogates replace costly simulation of stochastic and chemical dynamics
ranked.summary: Learned estimators are increasingly used in place of direct simulation for stochastic reaction networks, with reliability stated explicitly in one case.

ranked.headline: Genetic association methods map pleiotropy and cell-type liability in complex traits
ranked.summary: Large GWAS and rare-variant datasets now resolve pleiotropy, cell-type liability and candidate genes across psychiatric and neurological traits.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale genomes tie size and structural change to specific mechanisms
ranked.summary: Improved contiguity across planarian, termite, cattle and scrub-jay genomes now permits mechanistic attribution of genome architecture changes.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations resolve helicase unwinding and chromatin folding mechanisms
ranked.summary: Reduced-resolution simulations paired with experimental constraints access mechanistic states that are difficult to sample at atomistic detail.

ranked.headline: Reference libraries and peak detection advance untargeted metabolomics annotation
ranked.summary: Untargeted LC-MS workflows depend on accurate peak detection and curated MS/MS references for confident compound annotation.

ranked.headline: Computational tracing of atom origin and stereochemistry in metabolite structures
ranked.summary: Exact, scalable structure-level algorithms and curated mechanistic resources now enable atom-resolved and stereochemically aware analysis of metabolites and…

ranked.headline: SHAP attributions test whether CNN features track heterozygosity and LD statistics
ranked.summary: Interpretability of learned genomic models is now being tested against classical population-genetic summary statistics.

ranked.headline: Joint genetic models link regulators, epistasis and methylation to complex traits
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data and Perturb-seq regulatory networks now let genetically regulated co-expression, epistasis, and methylation variation be tested jointly…

ranked.headline: Adapting RNA-seq preprocessing and annotation tools to compact and bacterial genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and bacterial single-cell RNA-seq workflows now target operons, compact genomes, and runtime bottlenecks in isoform discovery.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware software for trait association, crossover inference and GBS simulation
ranked.summary: Four December 2025 tools formalize haplotype variants, haploblocks, crossover estimation and GBS simulation for trait and population analyses.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned design yields minimal nucleases and epitope-specific antibodies
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published workflow extend structure-first design to nucleases and antibody repertoires, weighing diversity against developability.

ranked.headline: Deep learning versus physics-based and co-folding models for predicting molecular binding
ranked.summary: Co-folding models are now being tested as drug-binding predictors and as training data for affinity scoring functions.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and machine learning link miRNA-DDR networks to pancreatic cancer survival
ranked.summary: Integrated multi-omics resources and ML models now predict actionable cancer driver panels and checkpoint response from TCGA and RNA-seq data.
